items.text: Weekend reports summary: EXPECTED Love (ankle), Odunze (calf); NOT EXPECTED Kamara (knee); ACTIVATED Josh Williams (Sean Tucker doubtful); NO NEWS YET Nabers (knee). Kamara status affects Etienne projection.
items.why: Aggregated weekend beat/insider reports for main slate.
items.implication: Lock main-slate decisions on Love/Odunze/Kamara; Nabers pending SNF.
items.opportunity: Etienne volume bump if Kamara out; Love/Odunze viable.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle, questionable) is expected to play vs Chargers.
items.why: Ankle sprain; progressing, sources confirm expectation to go.
items.implication: Startable with RB upside even if managed; monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Primary or shared backfield role; goal-line possible for others if limited.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (MCL/knee, questionable) is not expected to play vs Lions; full participant late in week but not quite ready.
items.why: MCL sprain; sources say not ready despite full Friday practice.
items.implication: Sit Kamara; elevate backup RBs in NO backfield for Week 1.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/targets for Travis Etienne and other NO RBs.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf, questionable) is expected to go vs Panthers.
items.why: Calf injury; limited practice but source says expected to play (possibly not full strength).
items.implication: Viable WR3/flex; have backup ready pre-inactives.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in CHI offense with Burden/Loveland also involved.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown is out about six weeks (injury update from GameDay Morning).
items.why: Injury detailed in Sunday morning updates.
items.implication: Long-term sit; NE WR depth and other pass-catchers elevated ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining NE WRs/TEs while out.

items.text: Falcons QB Cooper Rush (back spasms Sat) feeling better Sunday AM and expected to start vs Steelers (Tua/Penix out).
items.implication: ATL offense continuity for London/Bijan etc under Rush.
items.opportunity: Stable if limited ceiling vs higher-upside backups.

items.text: Main slate news largely locked. Malik Nabers (knee) for SNF murky and 'up to him'; Giants elevated WR Braxton Berrios and WR Dalen Cambre from PS. Projections updating.
items.why: Knee; full practice earlier but decision personal; elevations signal contingency.
items.implication: Monitor closely pre-SNF; Likely and other Giants pass-catchers rise if limited/out.
items.opportunity: If out/limited: targets to Isaiah Likely, Malachi Fields, others.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus trim) OUT for Week 1 vs Dolphins (expected 1-2 games); Michael Mayer steps into primary TE role.
items.why: Meniscus procedure earlier in week; confirmed OUT by coach/reports.
items.implication: Sit Bowers; stream/start Mayer in TE-needy spots.
items.opportunity: Mayer targets/routes as lead TE; Jeanty also cleared.

items.text: Week 1 snaps & pace: NO @ DET up in pace; MIA @ LV slow slog; CHI/CAR total nudged up 2-3 pts to 47.5. Updated on Tua/Bowers news.
items.why: Pace/snaps model + total movement post-injury news.
items.implication: Prefer NO-DET skill players for volume; fade MIA-LV pace.
items.opportunity: Higher play volume for Lions/Saints skill (Gibbs, St. Brown, Olave, Etienne).

items.text: Isaiah Likely ranks high in FPPG per target historically; Nabers won't be 100% Week 1 and Giants WR2 is Fields/Mooney—gimme all the Likely.
items.why: Elite per-target efficiency; Nabers limited + thin WR depth behind him.
items.implication: Start/stream Likely especially if Nabers limited/out.
items.opportunity: TE targets rise with Nabers uncertainty.

items.text: Maxx Crosby will play today for Raiders after telling teams (incl Rams) he did not want to be traded post-nixed Ravens deal.
items.why: Player preference shut down trade interest.
items.implication: LV defense at full strength vs MIA; minor IDP/DFS note.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is a flex play this week but viable; 'keeping it open' on The Chubbler.
items.why: Viable flex option amid CAR backfield.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes if lead or committee edge.

items.text: Contrarian: don't panic on CMC usage/Kaelon Black look in weird preseason/long-flight game; CMC is a BUY LOW.
items.why: Banged up preseason, travel, weird game context; not worried long-term.
items.implication: Hold/acquire CMC; fade overreaction to early usage optics.

items.text: When MHJ played 50%+ snaps last year, Michael Wilson averaged just 5.5 PPG / 13% share; off field Wilson jumped to 28%. MHJ expected to play.
items.why: Clear inverse target correlation with MHJ active.
items.implication: Fade Wilson if MHJ active; MHJ preferred.
items.opportunity: MHJ primary; Wilson only if MHJ limited.

items.text: Justin Herbert FPPG per pass attempt 52% higher with Joe Alt on field last year; Alt healthy and ready Sunday.
items.opportunity: Better pocket for Herbert, McConkey, etc.

items.text: Saquon Barkley vs Washington: since joining PHI averages 136.5 rush yds / 6.0 YPC and 21+ PPR in all 4 meetings (incl playoffs); WAS front still projects below avg.
items.why: Elite historical production in matchup; defensive context favorable.
items.opportunity: High carry/YPC ceiling in this spot.

items.text: Chris Olave with Tyler Shough: 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75% of those games last year; Lions safeties on IR; high O/U game.
items.why: Proven chemistry + favorable defensive injuries + game script.

items.text: Parker Washington: when 70%+ routes last year averaged 24% target share; career 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share. Browns CB Ward primarily on Brian Thomas Jr.
items.why: Route/target efficiency + favorable coverage shadow on teammate.
